learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore big numbers and learn how to count, read, and write up to thousands!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every digit in a number lives in its own house! There is the Ones house, the Tens house, the Hundreds house, and the big Thousands house.
Did you know that ten hundreds joined together make one big thousand? It is written as 1000 with three zeros!
To read a big number like 4521, we say Four Thousand, Five Hundred, and Twenty-One together.

fun_activity.title: 🔢 Number Plate Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Look at cars or scooters safely parked nearby. Try to read aloud the big 4-digit numbers on their number plates!

quick_recap: ⭐ Ten groups of one hundred make one big thousand.
⭐ Every digit in a big number has a special place and value.
⭐ We read the thousands and hundreds first, then the tens and ones together.
